card.name: Partway through longer English words
card.fires_on: The pole responds to the second piece of a split word, such as 'thereafter' after 'Shortly', 'acerb' in 'Exacerbation', or 'abouts' in 'thereabouts'. It appears in narrative and label text alike.

modes.label: After 'Shortly'
modes.description: The word 'thereafter' follows 'Shortly' at the start of a clause.
modes.example: Shortly<< thereafter>>, the ship was damaged in an attack

modes.label: Inside 'exacerbation'
modes.description: The middle piece 'acerb' sits in the word 'exacerbation' in warning headings.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: The middle or end piece of a longer word such as 'upholstered', 'thereabouts' or 'co-infuse'.

card.plain: It fires on the middle or end piece of some longer English words, and has no single meaning.
